baseline.allowance: Same frozen charged allowance per fibre as the class route; retain actual consumption and unequal backends.
baseline.comparison_gate: Seal both outputs before any evaluator reads both. Certify the combined subgroup, not just compare rank totals.
baseline.inputs: Identical equation and generic sixteen only; separate output directory and read allowlist.
baseline.method: Maintained MW16 upper-shell V3 with lean bounded map workers, exact admission and immediate rebuild after a gain.

constructor_policy.class_order: Chronological completed extraction checkpoint, then its deterministic coefficient-kernel order; retain a candidate only after strictness replay and incremental independence against G and previously retained candidates. Fix this before search; never rank by expected lift difficulty.
fresh_objects: cubic algebra and exact model maps
generic-only ordinary unramified characters and protected ideal anchors
factor-base labels and canonical rational-prime rows
principal-ideal dependency matrix and atom dictionary
constructor_policy.independence_characters: Evaluate away from complete factor support. A finite-character rank can certify independence but does not prove a guessed square identity.
constructor_policy.selection: Small representatives of unresolved ideal combinations, including pivot columns; protect only independently certified generic anchors. Retain all outside coordinates until cancellation. Fixed ordering and per-stage cutoffs must be frozen in the executable adapter before commissioning.
constructor_policy.source_generalization_status: PENDING: reference entry points have fixed paths, hard-coded generic strict dimensions and residue-degree-one dyadic assumptions. Generalize and verify these without reading fresh arithmetic outcomes; do not pass them off as a ready parameterized runner.

cost_measurement.accounting: Retain phase wall and process-tree CPU times separately, including startup and failures. Charge remote reduction requests with both reported CPU and full request elapsed time. Report setup/implementation separately. Remote/local clocks do not prove a speed theorem.
cost_measurement.aggregate_explanation: At most nine fibres including the control, two routes per fibre, two hours per route =36 worker-hours; this is a proposed worst-case ceiling, not expected consumption.
cost_measurement.missing_or_censored_C: Do not substitute 18.401 seconds, the historical subtotal, a timeout duration, or an unverified candidate for C. Keep this gate unresolved.
cost_measurement.proposed_fresh_allowance_rule: min(7200,ceil(2*C)) charged seconds per route, where C is the fully metered successful commissioning class route including all preparation, dependency construction, extraction, compaction, failed attempts, lifting, and independent verification.

endpoints.complementarity_success: The class-route point adds a certified direction to the subgroup in the sealed matched-endpoint V3 output.
endpoints.ordinary_ideal_class_increment: UNKNOWN unless separately certified by half-ideal/Artin detection; strict Kummer independence does not exclude a unit kernel.
endpoints.population_claim: Eight fibres give no general success-rate or parameter theorem.
endpoints.transfer_success: At least one fresh fibre supplies a newly constructed independently strict class outside G, an exact blind rational lift of that class, and a fresh independence certificate for G plus that point.

lifting.failure: RATIONAL_SOLUBILITY_UNKNOWN; a failed search is not Sha.
lifting.input_boundary: Only frozen candidate cover equations, norm invariant and exact source-model maps. No historical exceptional points, inherited roots/combinations, or V3 results.
lifting.method: Exact half-ideal square reduction and verified compaction; degree4 genus-one minimisation/reduction; conic parameterisation where available; degree2 minimisation/reduction; bounded rational quartic point search. Retain every transformation, miss and timeout.
lifting.point_verification: Independently substitute into original cover, replay every coordinate transport and cubic square identity, then check the original elliptic equation.

objective: One fresh equation-and-generic-only dependency, independently new strict class, blind rational lift and independently certified rank gain; test transfer before a new parameter theorem.
